uci_road_world_championships_edition.routing_guide: Use Doc when you need detailed information about a specific edition, such as its host city, country, or narrative description. If you need to compare multiple editions or perform aggregations, you may need to extract structured data from the documents or use a table if available. Since only Doc is present, rely on Doc for all queries, but consider extracting fields like year and host_city for structured operations.

Doc.description: Documents provide detailed textual descriptions of each edition, including the year, host city, host country, and other contextual information. Each document corresponds to a specific edition and includes fields such as doc_id, title, text, and linked_table_id.
